claims.claim: The user requested immediate Codex implementation via the cloud work chat.
The source describes an implementation target spanning 64 flower identities, six support lanes, a 32-slot architecture, and 768 flower-specific submodels.

The requested libraries include evidence-supported pure-flower soliflores, extract-led soliflores for owned floral naturals or product bases, controlled demonstration accords for floral-relevant aroma chemicals, and inventory-wide solinotes or material studies for eligible nonfloral odor materials.

The requested implementation includes an Inventory V5 crosswalk with every row classified exactly once or placed in an unresolved queue, bouquet roles, mixture topologies, n-ary interaction records, model lineage, controlled-test generation, and a physical chemical-box workflow ordered by mixing group and descending ingredient microliters.

The source requires target, inventory build, and actual bottle ledger separation; Missing-Chemical Impact; Meaningful Complexity gates; exact-stock enforcement; tests; canary; rollback; and truth-invariance checks.

The source explicitly distinguishes a single aroma chemical from a flower soliflore, Iris flower from Orris root, and Orris Liquid as an owned product basis with unknown internal active fraction; it describes Ambrettolide as computationally available but physically procurement-pending.
The source declares a 19-artifact packet with 2,805,089 copied artifact bytes and three packet-level SHA-256 identities.

The live inventory currently lists both Beta Ionone neat and Beta Ionone at 0.1% in TEC, while the recent user messages first stated neat availability and then stated 0.1%; this remains an explicit stock-strength conflict, not a resolved fact.

The live inventory lists Cypress EO and PADMA and marks Ambrettolide 10% in DPG OUT OF STOCK as of 2026-08-07; implementation must preserve those distinct states unless newer authoritative inventory evidence resolves them.
